carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the caudal peduncle, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and deep shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant semicircular notch or missing tissue segment is visible at the posterior-ventral tip of the lower caudal fin lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive distribution of high-luminance circular spots across the entire visible surface of the caudal fin, with a distinct horizontal alignment of spots following the trajectory of the lateral keel.
